data.final_week_advice: Use the final week for timed practice and mixed review to solidify all concepts before the exam.
data.summary: A focused six‑week plan that covers all AP Chemistry units, balances theory with practice, and culminates in a mixed review week. Each week includes a concrete task, a live class when available, and a short focus line.

weeks.focus: Atomic structure fundamentals and gas laws
tasks: Read 1.1 and 1.5 notes, then solve 15 mol‑mass problems with solutions; review 3.4 derivation and solve 10 ideal gas law problems; attend Class 9500 and take detailed notes on 3.1 and 3.2.
Create flashcards for 2.1 bond types; draw Lewis structures for 10 compounds (2.5); solve 15 stoichiometry word problems (4.5).

weeks.focus: Reaction mechanisms and net ionic equations
tasks: Do 10 rate law derivations (5.1,5.2); write net ionic equations for 8 reactions (4.2); attend Class 9501 and practice 4.1 and 4.2 problems.
Plot 5 energy diagrams (6.2); calculate ΔH for 5 reactions (6.1); solve 10 equilibrium constant problems (7.1).
Calculate pH for 5 weak acids (8.3); solve 10 kinetic rate problems (5.3); write a short essay on acid–base buffer systems (8.4).
Compute ΔG for 5 reactions (9.3); solve 10 entropy change problems (9.1); mixed review: timed practice of 30 mixed-topic questions covering all units.
